description: For one product: buy now, wait, skip or check fit first, optionally for a shopper who already owns a device or uses iPhone or Android, with a budget or a use. Returns a verdict (buy_now, wait, skip, check_fit or not_enough_data) and the rule behind it, reasons that each carry a source link and how sure iDevice is (Confirmed, Reported, Our read or No source on file), the fit with the shopper's phone platform, timing (a newer model out, announced or reported), price (iDevice's published verdict and the lowest retailer price in 90 days), what changed from the model the shopper owns when that comparison is on file, and which of those four parts could not be answered. Reported dates are worded as reported. No probability is given.

budget_usd.description: A price ceiling in US dollars

owned_device_slug.description: A product_slug of a device the shopper already owns, e.g. 'iphone-17'

owned_platform.description: The phone platform the shopper uses

product_slug.description: The product being considered, a product_slug, e.g. 'apple-watch'

use_case.description: What it is for, e.g. 'running' or 'sleep tracking'

name: should_i_buy
title: Should I buy this
